description:
Validate declared relative paths in repository inputs, profile packages and storage reads with the one path parser, `RootRelativePath::parse`, and delete the parallel predicates `is_safe_relative_path` and `validate_repo_relative_path` (REQ-20 safe relative paths).

## Background

- `is_safe_relative_path` (`crates/jit/src/domain/repository_inputs.rs:473-490`) checks the same rule as the domain `RootRelativePath::parse`: no backslash, colon, control character, Windows prefix, empty, `.` or `..` segment, or absolute path. They differ only on empty input, which the predicate rejects and the parser maps to the root.
- Callers: `DeclaredRoot::try_from` (`repository_inputs.rs:98-108`, which also admits the worktree root `.`), `validate_relative_path` in `crates/jit/src/profile/package.rs:871-880`, and the tar entry-name check in `crates/jit/src/profile/package_archive.rs:636-646`.
- `has_ordinary_segments` (`repository_inputs.rs:492-497`) stays: the exclusion-pattern shape check still uses it, since patterns admit `:` inside bracket expressions.
- Owning tests: `test_declared_root_rejects_paths_that_cannot_be_joined_to_a_worktree` (`repository_inputs.rs:574`) and the profile package unsafe-path tests.
- `validate_repo_relative_path` (`crates/jit/src/storage/path_errors.rs:57-74`, re-exported at `crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:74`) rejects only empty, absolute and `..`-bearing paths.
- `RepositoryLayout::classify_repository_relative` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs:627-657`) strips any leading `./` (`:636-638`) and then reaches `RootRelativePath::parse` through `VirtualPath::worktree`/`data`, so it refuses `a//b` and `a:b` but accepts `./a`. It has about fifty callers, among them gate prompt resolution (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:375`, `:856`), materialization and profile targets. This repository's `.jit/gates.toml` declares `prompt_file = "./contrib/gates/..."` and `"./scripts/..."` (`:15`, `:152`, `:207`, `:303`, `:414`), and `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:3504-3515` asserts the stripping. That function and its `./` rule stay unchanged.
- The working-tree read entry points check with the lax validator before classifying: `JsonFileStorage::read_repo_file` (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:1421-1443`, check at `:1426`) and `InMemoryStorage::repo_file_vpath` (`crates/jit/src/storage/memory.rs:244-252`, check at `:248`). So `read_repo_file("./a")` is accepted today. Production callers of `read_repo_file` pass configured item-kind sources and registries (`crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs:242`, `:273`); this repository's configuration spells none of them with `./`.
- Pinned reads apply only the lax check: `read_path_bytes` with `at_commit` (`json.rs:1456-1512`) validates with `validate_repo_relative_path` (`:1468`) and passes the text to the commit tree lookup, and `validate_path` (`crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:693-696`; after the git-module consolidation it lives in `crates/jit/src/storage/git.rs`) does the same. They accept `a//b`, `a:b`, `.` segments and backslashes.
- Other callers: `CommandExecutor::add_document` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:407-410`), `capture_artifact_evidence` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:417`, paired with `RootRelativePath::parse`), and `JsonFileStorage::inspect_artifact_location` (`json.rs:692`) while that method exists. The rustdoc of `crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:106` names the function.
- Owning storage tests: `test_read_repo_file_present_absent_and_path_safety` (`json.rs:1753`, `memory.rs:1178`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `is_safe_relative_path` no longer exists; its three callers accept a path exactly when `RootRelativePath::parse` returns a descendant, and reject the root (empty input).
- [hard] REQ-02: `validate_repo_relative_path` and its re-export no longer exist. Both backends' `read_repo_file` entry points, the pinned reads and the other listed callers check their argument with `RootRelativePath::parse` (rejecting the root), mapped to `PathReadError::InvalidPath` or the caller's existing invalid-path error; `read_repo_file` checks before classification. `classify_repository_relative` is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: The declared-root and profile package unsafe-path tests pass unchanged, and the declared-root test adds one case showing empty input is rejected.
- [hard] REQ-04: Both backends' path-safety tests assert that `read_repo_file("./a")` is refused, and the JSON backend's pinned-read test asserts that `a//b` and `a:b` are refused at a commit; each assertion fails today.
- [hard] REQ-05: The `classify_repository_relative` test at `commands/mod.rs:3504-3515` passes unchanged, so `./`-prefixed gate prompt paths still resolve.
- [hard] REQ-06: The `read_repo_file` contract rustdoc (`storage/mod.rs:325-348`) and the `validation/graph.rs` rustdoc name the one parser.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: the `read_repo_file` entry point refuses a leading `./` (a configured item-kind source or registry spelled `./x` is now an invalid path), and pinned reads refuse empty and `.` segments, `:`, `\` and control characters. Every other path input, including gate prompt files and materialization targets, keeps the `./` stripping of `classify_repository_relative`. Asserted by REQ-04 and REQ-05.
- Declared relative paths in repository inputs and profile packages behave as before: every input accepted or rejected before is accepted or rejected now.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Relative path inputs validate through RootRelativePath::parse
